english:
Plants a Well for 30 seconds, restoring 300 HP to you and dealing up to <pve 150 /> <pvp [?] /> damage while applying 40 stacks of <solar Scorch /> to enemies within 8.5 meters. Creates 3 Orbs of Power that each grant 3.6% Super Energy. Duration scales with your Super Stat, reaching 40 seconds at 200 Super.

The Well has 800 HP and can be <stasis Frozen /> and damaged by <stasis Shatter />. PvE Combatants deal 25% of normal damage to it.

You and allies within its 6 meter aura receive the following benefits:
• 25% increased Weapon Damage.
• 50 HP restored per second.
• 20% Damage Resistance against PvE Combatants, reduced to 10% against <link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />.
• 50% Damage Resistance against Players' <special/>Special Weapons, <heavy/>Power Weapons, and abilities; 40% against their <primary/>Primary Weapons.
• Immunity to <stasis Stasis /> effects.

The aura removes active <solar Restoration />. Leaving grants <solar Radiant /> for 8 seconds.

The caster's Weapon Damage inside counts as Super Ability Damage, and their kills inside can generate a maximum of 5 Orbs of Power.

// The source does not identify what grants the extra 20 Scorch stacks or 4 seconds of Radiant in its 40+20 and 8+4 notation. Cast damage has no supplied PvP value.

source.text:
Places down a Well of Radiance for 30 seconds, restoring 300HP to the caster, dealing up to 150 damage, and inflicting 40+20 Scorch to enemies within 8.5 metres.
Creates 3 Orbs of Power, each granting 3.6% Super Energy.
Super Duration scales with Super Stat, up to 40 seconds at 200 Super.

Well of Radiance:
Construct with 800 HP. Can be frozen and damaged by Stasis Shatter
Projects an aura that buffs the caster and allies within 6 metres. Leaving the aura grants Radiant for 8+4 seconds.
Combatants deal 0.25x Damage against the Well of Radiance.

For Guardians inside the Well of Radiance:
25% Increased Weapon Damage, 20% Damage Resist against Combatants (10% vs Boss Combatants), immunity to Stasis Effects, and restores 50HP/s.
Guardians receive 50% Damage Resist against Special and Power Weapons, as well as Abilities. Primary Weapons remain at 40% Damage Resist.
Removes any active Restoration effect. 
Weapon Damage dealt by the Caster is counted as Super Ability Damage. Caster can spawn up to 5 Orbs from scoring kills within the Well.
Tier 4 Super

Base Cooldown:
455 seconds
